extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n where n is a real number, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is a constant and f(x) is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a sum of functions equals the sum of their derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a difference of functions equals the difference of their derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of how a function changes as its input changes; represents instantaneous rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical function of the form e^x that is its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Base e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form a^x whose derivative is a^x · ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The first derivative of position with respect to time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of velocity with respect to time, or second derivative of position.

extracted_concepts.name: Position
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The location of an object at a given time, whose derivative yields velocity.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the cost function with respect to quantity produced.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of how one quantity changes in relation to another, connected to differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation, finding a function from its derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The process of finding antiderivatives or areas under curves, inverse to differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration as inverse operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function for which the derivative exists at every point in its domain.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm to the base e, used in the derivative of general exponential functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that can be expressed on a continuous number line, used as exponents in the power rule.
